points.what: EMEA was the biggest regional contributor to the order increase, contributing 32 orders, a 37.6% share of the total change.
points.so_what: EMEA drove the largest share of this week's order growth of any region.

points.what: Search was the biggest traffic-source contributor, contributing 63 orders, a 74.1% share of the total change.
points.so_what: Most of this week's order growth is concentrated in a single channel.

points.what: Facebook and Email contributed negatively to the order change, at -3 and -2 respectively.
points.so_what: These two channels declined this week while growth came from other channels.

points.what: AOV fell 4.6% WoW to 82.16 and is down 12.4% YoY.
points.so_what: Order growth, not order value, is behind this week's revenue increase.

points.what: Cancellation rate rose 0.2pp WoW to 12.9%, though it remains down 1.2pp YoY.
points.so_what: The rate is moving in the bad direction week over week even though it stays below last year's level.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of 2026-02-23 was 9.7%, up 0.7pp WoW and up 1.0pp YoY.
points.so_what: Returns for that week increased on both a weekly and yearly basis, a quality signal worth monitoring.

points.what: New signups were 260, flat WoW and up 1.6% YoY.
points.so_what: This growth pace is well below the 51.9% YoY increase in orders.

summary.headline: Mixed week: revenue beat target at 104.8% while orders fell short at 94.6%; the quarter remains behind at 93.1% QTD.

points.what: Orders were 828, up 11.4% WoW, reaching 94.6% of the weekly target.
points.so_what: Despite the WoW increase, orders stayed behind target, leaving a weekly shortfall.

points.what: Revenue was 59238, up 6.0% WoW, reaching 104.8% of the weekly target.
points.so_what: Revenue exceeded target this week even though orders fell short of theirs.

points.what: QTD revenue attainment stands at 93.1%, with two weeks left in the quarter.
points.so_what: The quarter remains behind target heading into its final two weeks.

points.what: AOV fell 4.6% WoW to 82.16, down 12.4% YoY.
points.so_what: Revenue growth this week came from more orders, not higher order values.

points.what: Orders reached 94.6% of the weekly target while revenue reached 104.8%, a gap of +2688 for revenue.
points.so_what: Revenue offset the order shortfall to still land ahead of the weekly target.

points.what: QTD revenue attainment is 93.1%, a gap of -44764, with 172424 still needed to reach the full quarter target.
points.so_what: The quarter needs stronger revenue in the remaining two weeks to close this gap.

points.what: YTD revenue attainment is 93.1%, requiring a weekly run-rate of 78254 versus the current 8-week run-rate of 54350.
points.so_what: The gap between the required and current run-rate shows the year needs a faster pace than recent weeks.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of 2026-02-23 rose to 9.7%, up 0.7pp WoW and up 1.0pp YoY.
points.so_what: The return rate is rising against both the prior week and last year, a bad-direction signal to track.

points.what: AOV fell 4.6% WoW and 12.4% YoY, both rated bad.
points.so_what: A falling AOV on both comparisons adds pressure on revenue per order.

points.what: The current 8-week revenue run-rate is 54350, well below the 78254 needed each week to reach the full-year target.
points.so_what: At the current pace, the full-year revenue target is out of reach.
